title: Influence of zinc substitution on the immune function of probands with vegetarian and vegan lifestyle
summary: Aim of the study is to analyze parameters of the immune response of vegans and vegetarians, which have shown a reduced zinc intake due to a food frequency questionnaire, after zinc supplementation.
conditions: Reduced zinc intake, which is not strictly fullfilling the ICD 10 code E60 for zinc deficiency.

interventions.name:
Vegans and Vegetarians
Zinc supplementation: 10mg zinc per day for 14 days

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Vegetarian or vegan for at least 3 months
Exclusion criteria:
Acute Infection
Intake of immune suppressive drugs
Pregnancy
Younger than 18 years
Drug or alcohol abuse
BMI over 29
